scope: Question checklist only. No legality, sanctions, export-control, customs or technical classification conclusions.

rules.check: Seller, buyer, country/region, product, contract value, currency and basic description are present.
rules.basisZh: 完整性检查：交易主体、标的、金额与基本结构应能与报价、订单和合同首页相互核对。
rules.basisEn: Completeness check: parties, subject matter, value and structure should reconcile across the quotation, order and contract cover.

rules.check: Advance and balance percentages total 100%, and milestones and conditions are stated.
rules.basisZh: 算术与可执行性检查：付款比例应一致，触发条件应能对应生产、出运或验收等可验证事件。
rules.basisEn: Arithmetic and operability check: percentages should reconcile and triggers should map to verifiable production, shipment or acceptance events.

rules.check: Incoterms rule, named place, shipment allocation and basic document responsibilities are stated.
rules.basisZh: 责任分配检查：贸易术语必须与指定地点结合，并与运输及单证责任保持一致。
rules.basisEn: Allocation check: the Incoterms rule must be paired with a named place and aligned with shipment and document responsibilities.

rules.check: Protected information, marking approach, exclusions and return/destruction arrangements are stated.
rules.basisZh: 合同完整性检查：确认保护对象、识别方式、合理例外及合同结束后的资料处理。
rules.basisEn: Contract completeness check: identify protected material, recognition method, reasonable exclusions and post-contract handling.

rules.check: Governing law and dispute method are stated; arbitration also identifies institution, seat and language.
rules.basisZh: 条款结构检查：只识别要素是否完整及是否明显矛盾，不判断哪个法域或仲裁安排一定最好。
rules.basisEn: Clause-structure check: identify missing or visibly inconsistent elements without prescribing the best law or arbitration arrangement.

rules.check: Contractual acceptance, reviewer, stage, payment effect and location of criteria are stated.
rules.basisZh: 合同机制检查：仅确认验收节点、责任人与付款关系；技术指标由 Engineering / Quality 判断。
rules.basisEn: Contract-mechanism check: confirm stage, owner and payment connection; Engineering / Quality decides technical criteria.

rules.check: Matters outside the checklist are routed without a substantive conclusion.
rules.basisZh: 边界规则：出口管制、制裁、产品技术属性、最终用途、技术标准及海关分类不得由本工具判断。
rules.basisEn: Boundary rule: this tool must not decide export controls, sanctions, product attributes, end use, technical standards or customs classification.
